title: Flutter / Supabase Developer
description:
# Flutter / Supabase Developer - Open Ended Contractor Position



We are looking for a skilled **Flutter / Supabase Developer** to help build and improve multiple SaaS applications currently in development.



This role is best for someone who can work with existing code, understand product requirements, think critically, and use AI tools efficiently to speed up development while still maintaining code quality.



## Responsibilities



* Build and improve Flutter features for mobile and web

* Work with Supabase Auth, Postgres, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions, and Row Level Security

* Create and update database tables, policies, functions, and migrations

* Debug frontend, backend, and database issues

* Improve app performance, usability, and responsiveness

* Integrate third-party services when needed

* Review existing code and understand how different parts of the platform connect

* Use AI tools efficiently for development, debugging, and code review

* Verify AI-generated code instead of blindly trusting it

* Communicate progress, blockers, and technical concerns clearly



## Required Skills



* Strong experience with Flutter and Dart is preferred

* Experience with Supabase is preferred

* Understanding of Postgres, authentication, roles, permissions, and secure data access is preferred

* Ability to work with existing codebases

* Ability to debug issues across frontend and backend layers

* Good communication skills

* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

* Ability to use AI tools responsibly and efficiently

* Strong willingness to learn, improve, and grow technically



We strongly encourage driven developers to apply, even if they do not currently have experience with every technology listed above. We have had great success working with developers who started without direct experience in our stack but advanced quickly through discipline, curiosity, critical thinking, and effective use of AI tools. A strong work ethic, the ability to learn fast, and the desire to improve are highly valued.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Riverpod

* go_router

* Supabase Row Level Security

* Supabase Edge Functions

* Supabase Storage

* Flutter Web

* UI/UX design experience

* Ability to create clean, user-friendly screens and workflows

* Experience improving layouts, navigation, usability, and visual consistency

* SaaS platforms

* Marketplace platforms

* Healthcare or compliance-focused software

* Payment integrations

* Notification systems

* File upload workflows

* GitHub, pull requests, and code reviews

* CI/CD workflows



## Team Culture



We are building more than just software. We are building a team that works closely together, learns together, and grows together.



Once a year, we bring our contractors together in Ormoc City, Leyte for an in-person team summit. The summit is held at a resort and is focused on team building, product alignment, professional development, and strengthening working relationships.



These summits give the team a chance to step away from daily development work, meet face-to-face, discuss company direction, review product goals, share ideas, and build stronger trust with one another. We believe that strong professional relationships lead to better communication, better collaboration, and better long-term results.



Our goal is to create an environment where contractors feel connected to the mission, respected as part of the team, and motivated to keep growing personally and professionally.



## Important Expectations



We are looking for someone who can do more than just complete assigned tickets. The right developer should be able to understand the purpose of a feature, think through the workflow, identify potential issues, and suggest better solutions when appropriate.



AI tools are part of our development workflow, but the developer must be able to review, test, and validate AI-generated code. We expect clean, maintainable work and good judgment.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who:



* Can work independently

* Can understand business logic, not just code tasks

* Can ask good questions when requirements are unclear

* Can use AI to work faster without depending on it blindly

* Can think through security, user experience, and scalability

* Can communicate clearly

* Has an eye for clean, user-friendly design

* Takes ownership of assigned work



## How to Apply



Please send:



* A short introduction about yourself

* Your Flutter experience

* Your Supabase experience

* Any UI/UX design experience or examples of screens you have designed or improved

* Examples of apps or projects you have worked on

* Your GitHub, portfolio, or sample code if available

* A short explanation of how you use AI tools in your development workflow



Compensation will be discussed during the interview process.

The primary focus of this role is financial ownership — taking control of Xero, reconciliation, payroll, invoicing, and cross-entity cost allocation so the business owner can step back from daily financial tasks and operate at CEO level.



This is not a generalist VA role with bookkeeping bolted on. The financial function is the core, with reporting and operational support built around it. The right person will be very analytically strong, proactively autonomous, and capable of growing into a financial reporting function over time.



Role Details

Employment Type: Full-Time Virtual Tea
mber

Working Hours: 7:00am – 4:00pm AEST





What Success Looks Like

The director opens a weekly report and has a clear picture of every project's financial and operational status — without digging for the data himself.

Reconciliation, payroll, and invoicing are handled accurately and on time, every week.

A financial dashboard is built and maintained across all active projects.

Red flags — budget depletion without milestone completion, cost overruns, allocation errors — are surfaced proactively before the director notices them.

SOPs are documented as each task is handed over, building a reliable knowledge base.



Key Responsibilities

Financial Management & Bookkeeping

Daily bank reconciliation in Xero across all entities

Invoice management: review, allocate and confirm drafts from project management platforms into Xero

Weekly payroll processing for permanent and ad hoc staff

Weekly supplier payments, transitioning from daily to weekly pay runs

Cross-entity expense allocation across residential, remedial and government business lines

BAS and IAS preparation each quarter

Quarterly Xero business line review to catch misallocations across three tracking codes

Monthly P&L compilation

Ad hoc quoting and tender documentation support



Reporting & Financial Dashboard

Build and maintain a weekly financial dashboard across all active projects: contract sum, current costs, forecasted costs and variances

Weekly cash flow reporting and monthly detailed cash flow comparisons (month-on-month and year-on-year)

Cash flow projection modelling including milestone impact scenarios

Extract and compile schedule and progress data for the director's weekly project overview

Proactively flag red flags: budget depletion without milestone completion, cost overruns, allocation errors



Day-to-Day Communication & Task Management

Send a morning WhatsApp message with priorities for the day

Send an end-of-day
 report covering completed tasks, work in progress, and items requiring the director's attention or approval

Manage and maintain the Trello task board across daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Operational & Administrative Support

Project administration: building contracts and paperwork for project commencement and completion

Technology Stack

WhatsApp: Primary day-to-day communication: morning messages and task clarifications

 (Outlook): Formal communication and end-of-day reports





Qualifications & Experience

Essential

Strong bookkeeping background with hands-on Australian Xero experience — non-negotiable

Familiarity with Australian tax obligations: BAS, IAS, payroll, and GST allocation

Comfortable managing financial complexity across multiple entities or business lines

Analytically strong — capable of building dashboards and reports from raw platform data

Understands project-based financials: milestone tracking, budget vs actuals, cost forecasting

Proactive communicator with strong written and verbal English

Able to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment without daily direction



Preferred

Construction or trades industry exposure — fast learning of industry-specific platforms is essential if not

Degree in accounting or finance (not mandatory if competence is clearly demonstrated)

Experience with Excel for dashboards and reporting

Prior familiarity with WunderBuild or similar construction project management platforms



Who You Are

The person who thrives in this role will recognise themselves in most of the following:



Analytical Thinker — you go beyond processing data to interpreting it. You spot patterns, flag anomalies and ask why when something looks off.

Proactively Autonomous — you don't wait to be told what to do next. You work through your task list and communicate progress without needing to be chased.

Detail-Obsessed — you catch the small things: the misallocated invoice, the GST error, the milestone not ticked but the budget almost gone.

Fast Learner — you pick up new platforms and processes quickly and don't need hand-holding once shown.

Calm Communicator — you can keep pace with a fast-moving, ideas-driven director without getting flustered. You ask the right questions to get clarity.

Systems Builder — you naturally document what you do. You see the value in SOPs and contribute to them without being asked.

Commercially Aware — you understand that the numbers you manage represent real projects, real deadlines, and real consequences.

Reliable Under Routine — you handle repetitive financial tasks with consistent accuracy and never treat routine as low priority.

Initiative-Taker — you don't just tick tasks. You see what's coming, prepare for it, and surface things the director doesn't yet know he needs to know.

Discreet and Trustworthy — you will have access to sensitive financial data across multiple entities and partnership structures. Confidentiality is non-negotiable.



Important Notes for Applicants

A few things to be aware of before applying:



This business operates across multiple entities (residential, remedial, and government), each with separate Xero tracking codes and, in some cases, separate bank accounts. Cross-entity cost allocation is a core task from day one. You must be comfortable managing this complexity.

The director is direct, fast-moving, and high-achieving. He will respond well to someone who pushes back constructively, asks the obvious question, and shows initiative. A passive or overly deferential approach will not be a good fit.

This is not a task-ticking role. We are looking for someone who creates tasks as much as completes them.

The director generates ideas and instructions quickly, not always framed as formal tasks. Capturing everything, distinguishing between 'idea I just had' and 'immediate action', and flagging medium-term items is a core part of the job.

Red flag identification — recognising signals like a milestone not completed but the budget nearly depleted — is a trained skill, not a day-one expectation. However, the analytical mindset and commercial awareness to get there must already exist.

title: Resource Manager / Recruitment Specialist
description:
Resource Manager / Recruitment Specialist (Remote, Part-Time)

We're a labour hire and workforce solutions business operating across WA, NSW, and VIC — placing skilled workers across landscaping, forestry, construction, mining, horticulture, and civil industries. Arrange accommodation for field staff on remote projects within budget parameters and company standards



Recruitment & HR Coordination

Screen applicants, conduct reference checks, verify qualifications, and manage candidate pipelines to align with project timelines

Coordinate onboarding for new hires: induction scheduling, compliance training, and ensuring all site access requirements are met before workers arrive

Reporting & Administration

Prepare monthly staffing and resource allocation reports for the management team

Collect and upload site-specific Safety Reports to 
 by the 25th of each month

 as the workforce changes

Daily Communication & Online Office



Participate in the virtual online office — video connection maintained throughout the working day

Communicate availability transparently: log your schedule in the company system and keep it current without being prompted; flexible hours are fine, invisible hours are not

Raise questions in real time rather than allowing uncertainty to produce errors downstream

Use Timely (AI time tracker) to log and summarise daily activity accurately





What We're Looking For

Experience



Previous experience in HR coordination, resource management, or recruitment administration — essential

Demonstrable experience with payroll data entry, preferably using Deputy and/or Xero

Experience recruiting for high-volume, casual workforces is a significant advantage

Background in environmental, agricultural, construction, or field operations industries preferred — strong fast learners considered

 — project and employee management; prior use preferred, training available

You'll Thrive Here If You Are…

Numbers-confident — Genuinely at ease working with data, payroll figures, and cross-referenced spreadsheets all day. This is not a role for someone who tolerates numbers; it's for someone who is comfortable making them their core daily output.

s

title: Full-Time Graphic Designer & Social Video Content Creator
description:
About Us

Reputation Elevation provides a full suite of digital marketing services, with a special focus on the autism therapy (ABA) space. Innovation, exceptional client service, and real results are at our core. Our design team produces a high volume of paid-social and Google ad creative — fast, on-brand, and built to perform.



The Role

We’re hiring a full-time Graphic Designer and Social Media Video Creator with genuine taste and creative instinct. You have a sharp eye for design, you can write a headline that stops the scroll, and you can turn a brief into polished image and video ads quickly. You’ll work closely with our ads team to concept and produce creative that wins attention and drives leads.

This is a high-output, direct-response role. You’ll often work within strict brand and content constraints (more on that below) and still find a way to make the work feel fresh. If you love the craft of making one ad clearly outperform another, you’ll fit in here.

Creativity is only half the job. The other half is execution: being quick, organized, and meticulous. A typical assignment is a set of graphics and short videos due in 3 business days — and “due in 3 business days” means done in 3 business days. Many clients run campaigns in multiple cities, so you’ll often produce near-identical creative sets that differ only in the details — the Atlanta set says Atlanta, the Savannah set says Savannah, and every location-specific element is right in each one. If that level of precision sounds tedious, this isn’t the role; if it sounds obvious, read on.



What You’ll Do

• Concept and produce high-quality image and video ads for
/Instagram and Google.

• Write short, punchy on-asset copy and headlines — not just lay out design.

• Tailor creative to ABA therapy providers and our other client industries.

• Localize creative sets for multi-market clients — same campaign, different city — getting every location-specific detail right on every version.

• Use generative AI as a core part of your workflow to move fast without sacrificing taste.

• Partner with the ads team to understand each client and ship creative that hits the campaign goal.

• Turn work around on schedule — a standard set of graphics and short videos is assigned with a 3-business-day deadline, and it ships on time, every time.

• Deliver organized, editable source files for everything you make.

• Keep current on what’s working in paid-social creative and bring ideas to the table.



Tools You’ll Use

We care about output and taste more than any specific software, but you should be fluent across these categories:

• Canva — core to our workflow; you should be very comfortable here.

• AI video generation — comfort with current AI video tools for generating and animating ad footage.

• Image editing — a professional editor such as Photoshop (or equivalent).

• AI image generation — generating and refining on-brand still imagery.

• Video editing — assembling short-form video with text, captions, and music.

How We Work

• Schedule — Full-time. You set your own hours, but you must be reliably available for live overlap from 3:00–6:00 PM Israel time for calls and feedback.

• Deadlines — A typical assignment is a set of graphics and short videos with a 3-business-day turnaround. Deadlines are firm; if something threatens one, you flag it early, not on the due date.

• Project management — Assignments are managed in ClickUp.

• File handling — All work, including editable source files, is uploaded to our shared Google Drive.

• Ad accounts — You may be added to our clients’
 Ads accounts to upload creative.



Content Standards (Please Read)

Our ABA therapy clients require brand-safe, conservative creative. The first rule applies to every asset; the depiction rules apply whenever people appear:

• The word “autism” or “ABA therapy” must be clearly visible in the text of every ad.

• When people are shown, they’re conservatively dressed — elbows, knees, and collarbones covered — with conservative hairstyles.

• Any children depicted read as ordinary, neurotypical kids.

• When therapists are shown, they wear casual professional clothing — no lab coats or scrubs.

If tightly constrained creative frustrates you, this likely isn’t the right role. If you see constraints as a fun problem to solve, you’ll thrive.

We only view job applications from people who really read this through. Prove you read this by including the word “elephant” in your application message.



Creative Range (Also Please Read)

The rules above govern what appears on an asset — they do not mean every ad shows a therapy session, a child, or even a person. Many of our best-performing creatives don’t. Styles in our rotation include:

• Text-only — typographic ads where the headline is the design.

• Mood-setting — e.g., aerial footage of a beautiful landscape with a line about autism or ABA written over it.

• Animated — animation works when it’s tasteful; it must never read as anime or feel immature.

• UGC-style — an image or video of a parent at home, or a therapist working while a parent watches, with text on top. Feels authentic rather than produced.



That list isn’t a menu to pick from — it’s a starting point. There are endless creative styles to innovate, and part of this job is bringing us formats we haven’t tried. We want someone who works within our rules and keeps pushing the style range.



What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience designing paid-social / direct-response ad creative (image and video). Please share a portfolio of ad work specifically — not only brand or editorial pieces.

• A strong eye for layout, type, and what makes a scroll-stopping ad.

• A style innovator — someone who moves fluently between text-only, mood-driven, animated, and UGC-style formats, and keeps proposing new ones we haven’t tried.

• Solid short-form copy/headline instincts.

• Real, current experience using generative AI for images and graphics.

• Sharp attention to detail — especially across near-duplicate versions of the same creative (different cities, phone numbers, offers) where one wrong detail means a wrong ad goes live.

• Organized and dependably on time — you manage multiple clients and deadlines at once, hit a 3-business-day turnaround consistently, and never drop quality to do it.

• Clear communicator who collaborates well with a remote team.

• Pluses: experience in the ABA therapy / autism space, and the ability to produce high-quality AI-generated video ads.



Our Hiring Process

Four steps, in this order:

1. Video screener — a short, asynchronous video Q&A via VideoAsk. A few quick questions you answer on camera, on your own schedule. No preparation needed.

2. Portfolio — send a portfolio of paid-social / direct-response ad work (image and video). Given the conservative standards of our client base, portfolios must contain no indecent or risqué imagery — submissions that include it will not be reviewed.

3. Paid test assignment — a small, paid creative brief done to a real deadline, so we can see your taste, your process, and your reliability under our actual working conditions.

4. Interview — a live conversation about your work, your test, and the role.



What We Offer

• Full-time remote role with flexibility in how you structure your day.

• A supportive, collaborative team that ships a lot of work.

• Real impact on our clients’ marketing results.

• Competitive compensation based on experience and skill.

Join us in creating visually stunning, high-performing ad campaigns that make a difference.

title: Amazon Wholesale Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Amazon Wholesale Virtual Assistant (VA) to manage and grow our US-to-US wholesale operations. The ideal candidate will have deep, proven knowledge of the Amazon Wholesale workflow, from sourcing and analysis to inventory management and supplier relations, specifically within the United States market.



Key Responsibilities (US Wholesale Operations)



The core focus of this role is managing the entire wholesale cycle:



1.? ?Product Sourcing & Analysis:



Conduct in-depth product research to identify profitable brand/wholesale opportunities (US Brands/Distributors only).

Analyze product profitability using tools like Keepa, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar, accounting for all Amazon and logistics fees.   

Vet potential products based on Buy Box stability, Sales Rank, competition, and listing quality.   



2.? ?Supplier Relations & Acquisition:



Professionally contact US-based wholesale suppliers and distributors via
 and phone to open new accounts.

Manage a pipeline of supplier leads and follow up diligently to secure price lists and catalogs.

Negotiate pricing, MOQs (Minimum Order Quantities), and payment terms to maximize profit margins. 

 

3.? ?Inventory & Order Management:



Create and manage Purchase Orders (POs) with suppliers.

Plan, create, and track FBA (Fulfillment by Amazon) shipments to US fulfillment centers.   

Monitor inventory levels in Amazon Seller Central to prevent stockouts and overstock.   

Reconcile FBA shipments and open cases with Amazon Seller Support for discrepancies.



4.? ?Amazon Seller Central Management:



Create and optimize product listings (titles, bullet points, descriptions) to ensure accuracy and compliance.   

Monitor and manage Account Health, addressing any issues (e.g., policy violations, customer feedback) promptly.

Utilize repricing software to maintain competitiveness and win the Buy Box.   



Required Skills & Qualifications



Hands-on experience as an Amazon Wholesale VA/Manager.

Expert proficiency with Amazon Seller Central.

Deep understanding of the US Wholesale model and logistics (US-to-US FBA).

Expert user of essential Amazon tools (e.g., Keepa, Tactical Arbitrage, Helium 10, Inventory Lab, or similar).   

Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for professional supplier outreach.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to work independently to meet deadlines.

Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets for data analysis and reporting.

Reliable, high-speed internet connection and a dedicated workspace.



How to Apply



Please submit your application with the following:



•Your updated CV/Resume.

•A brief cover letter highlighting your specific Amazon Wholesale experience and the exact wholesale tools you are an expert in.

•In your application subject line, please write: "US Wholesale VA - [Your Favorite Amazon Tool]" (e.g., "US Wholesale VA - Keepa"). This is to ensure you have read the entire job post.

•Your expected hourly rate or salary range.



We look forward to reviewing your application!



Thanks,

Hafi

title: Amazon online arbitrage
description:
We are seeking an independent, organized, and highly experienced Virtual Assistant to join our e-commerce team and take full ownership of product sourcing for online arbitrage (OA) between the UK and US Amazon marketplaces.



You will be responsible for finding profitable arbitrage opportunities, using various sourcing techniques and tools, and working with minimal supervision. This is a role for someone who already understands the OA landscape, can manage their own sourcing schedule, and can deliver consistent, well-researched leads that meet specific criteria.



Key Responsibilities



Independently source profitable OA products from US retailers for UK Amazon (and vice versa if needed).



Conduct daily manual and automated sourcing using reverse sourcing, storefront stalking, Keepa analysis, etc.



Evaluate and validate product opportunities using tools like Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, BuyBotPro, Tactical Arbitrage, Helium 10, and Amazon Seller Central.



Maintain detailed and organized sourcing spreadsheets (e.g., Google Sheets, Excel).



Meet daily/weekly product lead targets with high-quality, buy-ready leads.



Identify trends, seasonal opportunities, and replenishables across categories (toys, beauty, home, etc.).



Track and report performance metrics (ROI, sales rank, profit, BSR, competition, etc.).



Communicate effectively with the team, flagging any issues or opportunities in the marketplace.





Minimum hands-on experience in Online Arbitrage sourcing (Amazon FBA preferred).



Understanding of Amazon UK and US marketplaces.



Excellent working knowledge of Keepa (must be able to read and interpret charts confidently).



Advanced experience with:



? SellerAmp SAS



? BuyBotPro



? Tactical Arbitrage



? Keepa



? Amazon Seller Central



? Google Sheets / Excel



Strong understanding of ROI, net profit, BSR, IP alerts, restrictions, hazmat, and gating.



Ability to work independently, manage time efficiently, and hit daily KPIs.



Proficient in English (written and spoken).



Bonus: Knowledge of ASINspector, OA Deals platforms, Prep Centers, or Repricer tools.

title: Content Writer (Webinar Presentations)
description:
If you enjoy building high-converting webinar presentations, following a clear, systematic process, and using AI to scale your writing, keep reading.



About us:

We’re the Creade Club. We coach Sport-Creators to benefit more from their audience. Clients are mostly successful Sport-Creators who are having trouble improving their business further.



We’re now hiring a Remote Webinar Copywriter to help us build high-converting presentations for our clients. The job is creative but systematic: you don't invent decks from scratch; you adapt a proven structure to each client. Your focus is strictly on the text/copy—the words on each slide. You are not designing anything. We do this work using Claude AI, so the whole build runs as a guided process inside a Claude project.



What you’ll do:

- Run guided AI workflows

- Adapt proven structures

- Manage slide tiers

- Define key variables

- Perfect the pacing

- You are not designing



What we provide:

- Detailed client intake forms containing all the raw material you need.

- Structural wireframes (marked with evergreen and near-evergreen identifiers) to act as your map.

- Starter prompts to load into Claude AI to initiate the build smoothly.

- Examples of high-converting presentations to reference for pacing and structural adaptation.



You’re a fit if:

- You know when to write fresh copy and when to leave proven "evergreen" assets alone.

- You understand how to pace a presentation for speaking, using sentence fragments rather than paragraphs.

- You have excellent editorial judgment and can synthesize a client's core promise into a highly effective opening "Hook."

- You enjoy directing and refining AI outputs rather than writing every single word from a blank page.



Requirements:

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, specifically for spoken presentations or webinars.

Comfortable operating workflows within AI platforms like Claude.

Available for team communication and questions between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM German time (your actual working hours are flexible).

Strong written and spoken English.

Reliable internet, a working computer, a webcam, and a quiet place to work.



How to apply: 

This is a short form where we ask about your experience, portfolio (please include copywriting or presentation examples), and availability.



If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we’ll offer you an assessment task to test how you run our Claude workflow.



Top candidates from the assessment task will be invited to a short 1:1 call and a paid trial period.



Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Remote

title: GoHighLevel Sub-Account Deployment Specialist (Roofing Niche)
description:
TYPE: Part-time, 20 hrs/wk to start. Long-term. Async-friendly (AWST overlap preferred but not required).



ABOUT THE ROLE:



I run a local AI automation agency serving roof restoration businesses in Perth, Australia. We install a pre-built GoHighLevel system into each client account — reviews automation, missed call text-back, online booking, and GBP post scheduling.



You will own the technical deployment of each new client account from snapshot load to go-live. Each install takes 2–3 hours. We're onboarding 2–3 new clients per month initially, scaling to 10 total.





WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH INSTALL:



- Create new GHL sub-account under agency

- Load roofing snapshot, resolve any conflicts

- Connect client's GBP to GHL Reputation Management

- Set up LC Phone, test missed call text-back workflow end-to-end

- Configure Conversation AI knowledge base with client-specific info

- Customise landing page (swap name, phone, suburb list, photos)

- Enable AI Employee (Reviews AI + Conversation AI) per sub-account

- Schedule first 3 GBP posts in Social Planner

- QA every workflow on a test contact before handover

- Record a Loom walkthrough for the client showing what's live



ONGOING (monthly):



- Monitor review request workflows — flag any failures

- Update GBP post queue monthly (templates provided, you schedule)

- Respond to any workflow issues flagged by clients



MUST HAVE:



- 2+ years hands-on GoHighLevel experience

- Snapshot deployment experience (describe a specific example)

- GBP connection + Reputation Management setup

- Conversation AI knowledge base configuration

- LC Phone setup and workflow testing

- Loom + Notion for SOPs



NICE TO HAVE:



- Experience with home services / trades niche

- GHL SaaS Mode familiarity

- Australian client experience



TO APPLY:



Send a Loom video (max 5 min) showing either:

    (a) a snapshot you've deployed, or

    (b) a Conversation AI knowledge base you've configured.

No video = no reply.

title: Direct-Response Video Editor VSLs — Part-Time
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce health & wellness brand. We sell a red-light therapy device that helps women over 50 relieve hip pain caused by menopause. We sell through native-style video ads (VSLs) on Meta and are scaling fast.



We are looking for a skilled DIRECT-RESPONSE VIDEO EDITOR to turn our scripts into high-converting VSLs. You will NOT write copy — we deliver the full script, the hooks, and part of the video material. Your job is to make it convert.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit 2–4 VSLs per week (we start with 2, then scale based on results)

- Turn our scripts, hooks and beat-mapping into finished, polished video ads

- Generate and sync voiceover using ElevenLabs (script delivered in English, beat-mapped exactly)

- Add captions, B-roll, pacing, sound design and visual hooks that hold attention

- Source extra B-roll or simple motion graphics when needed

- Iterate fast on winning angles when we ask for variations

(We expect roughly 8–10 hours per VSL.)



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

- Proven DIRECT-RESPONSE editing experience — you have edited VSLs or native ads for a real e-commerce brand before (not just YouTube/social content)

- Strong editing skills in CapCut

- ElevenLabs voiceover generation and clean audio sync

- Animated / word-by-word captions (CapCut auto-captions or Submagic)

- Fluent English (required — all communication and beat-mapping is in English)

- Strong sense of pacing, retention and hook structure for direct-response ads



NICE-TO-HAVE (BIG PLUS)

- Understanding German is a MASSIVE advantage (our audience is German-speaking)

- Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects for cleaner cuts and simple motion graphics

- B-roll sourcing (Storyblocks, Artgrid, etc.)

- Experience editing for a health, wellness, supplement or 50+ audience



TOOLS WE USE

CapCut, ElevenLabs, Submagic, Google Drive / 
, Meta Ads, Slack



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

- VSLs delivered on deadline

- Editing quality and retention (hooks, pacing, captions)

- Speed of iteration on winning angles

- Ad performance — strong performers earn a bonus



WORK STYLE

High-performance, fast-moving e-commerce environment. We value ownership, speed and people who think about WHY an ad converts. Workload is project-based and flexible, but deadlines are firm. Start date: June 7th (ASAP).



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY — this is our first filter)

Applications missing any of these will be ignored:



1) Your portfolio / reel including:

   - Which brands you have worked with, and FOR HOW LONG

   - What position / role you held at each

   - A short clip of a VSL or native ad you edited (a cut-down sample is fine)



2) Answer in writing:

   "What is the single most valuable lesson you have learned that you see again and again at every SUCCESSFUL e-commerce brand?"



3) A 60-second Loom video where you:

   - Briefly introduce yourself

   - Explain WHY a VSL for a woman over 50 must be edited differently than a VSL for a Gen-Z supplement audience



Apply by sending your portfolio, your written answer, and your Loom link.

title: Customer Operations Specialist
description:
Working hours: Full time, UK hours (9am–5:30pm GMT)



Location: Remote - Luzon residents preferred (we occasionally host in-person tea
et-ups and the majority of our Philippines-based team live on Luzon)



*About Us*



Zencity is a mission-driven startup re-inventing the way governments hear from, understand, and engage with their residents. Our community voices solution and community survey services use advanced AI to help government organizations make data-driven decisions.



Our global team of urban enthusiasts and data geeks works with over 300 cities - from Los Angeles to London. If you’re passionate about joining a growing and dynamic company focused on leveraging data and tech to work on real-world challenges and radically improve life in cities - your place is with us!



*About The Role*



The Operations Specialist plays a central role in keeping our business operations running smoothly. You’ll succeed in this role if you’re organised, flexible and pro-active, with a strong eye for detail.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Creating and configuring new client setups

- Connecting data sources

- Building surveys and content pages

- Troubleshooting configuration issues raised by clients or internal teams, escalating to product or engineering where appropriate

- Training our AI models

- Running reports

- Content moderation

- Data extraction

- Maintaining accurate records in our ticketing and project tracking tools (Zendesk, Hubspot, 
)

- Helping cover Support tickets during peak periods or coverage gaps



This is a remote role - you'll need a stable internet connection and power supply to begin with, you’ll also need to own a computer/laptop capable of joining Zoom calls, running web-based software, etc. After your probationary period (3 months), we'll provide you with a company laptop and backup power supply if needed.



*Requirements*



Essential:

- Exceptional English - flawless written English and highly proficient spoken English

- Detail-obsessed - you spot the typo, the misaligned setting, the wrong category that everyone else missed

- Tech-savvy and quick to learn - comfortable picking up new web-based platforms, configuration tools, and CRMs

- Self-motivated and reliable - you manage your time, you're present and responsive during your shift, and you follow through on what lands in your hands

- Strong communicator - you escalate early, flag risks ahead of time, and write clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Resilient and adaptable - comfortable in a fast-moving scale-up with ambiguity and shifting priorities



Desirable:

- 1+ years in a SaaS implementation, configuration, onboarding, or technical support role

- Working knowledge of HTML/CSS, or experience configuring/customising web-based platforms

- Experience running QA, pre-launch checks, or structured testing against documented criteria

- Experience with helpdesk and project tracking tools (Zendesk, HubSpot, 
, Jira, or similar)

- Experience with surveys, forms, or community engagement tools



*How We Work*



We hold ourselves to a high professional standard, and we expect the same of every tea
mber. That means:

- Being present, reliable, and reachable during your scheduled hours - at your workstation, in Slack, and joining meetings on time with your camera on

- Communicating early when something goes wrong - power cuts and internet drops happen, but we need to hear from you before you disappear, not after

- Taking ownership of what lands in your queue and following it through to resolution, or handing it off cleanly with full context

- Treating SLAs as commitments, not guidelines - and escalating early when at risk of missing one

- Asking for help when you need it - there is no shame in not knowing the answer, only in not asking

description:
If you enjoy building high-converting webinar presentations, following a clear, systematic process, and using AI to scale your writing, keep reading.



About us:

We’re the Creade Club. We coach Sport-Creators to benefit more from their audience. Clients are mostly successful Sport-Creators who are having trouble improving their business further.



We’re now hiring a Remote Webinar Copywriter to help us build high-converting presentations for our clients. The job is creative but systematic: you don't invent decks from scratch; you adapt a proven structure to each client. Your focus is strictly on the text/copy—the words on each slide. You are not designing anything. We do this work using Claude AI, so the whole build runs as a guided process inside a Claude project.

- Run guided AI workflows

- Adapt proven structures

- Manage slide tiers

- Define key variables

- Perfect the pacing

- You are not designing

- Examples of high-converting presentations to reference for pacing and structural adaptation.



You’re a fit if:

- You know when to write fresh copy and when to leave proven "evergreen" assets alone.

- You understand how to pace a presentation for speaking, using sentence fragments rather than paragraphs.

- You have excellent editorial judgment and can synthesize a client's core promise into a highly effective opening "Hook."

- You enjoy directing and refining AI outputs rather than writing every single word from a blank page.



Requirements:

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, specifically for spoken presentations or webinars.

Comfortable operating workflows within AI platforms like Claude.

Available for team communication and questions between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM German time (your actual working hours are flexible).

Strong written and spoken English.

Reliable internet, a working computer, a webcam, and a quiet place to work.

title: UGC Video Editor - Ecommerce
description:
Fill out form: (ADD PORFOLIO IN FORM, NO PORTFOLIO = APPLICATION NOT ACCEPTED)






UGC EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

AGENCY EXPERIENCE PREFERRED



About Us

We're a company running 7–8 figure DTC brand portfolios operating across the US, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Our growth runs through paid social - Meta and TikTok at a serious scale, which means video is at the center of everything we do. We produce a high volume of UGC-style and direct-response ad creative, and we need editors who can keep up without the output quality slipping.



This isn't a passion project or a content agency. The videos we edit run as paid ads, and the numbers tell us immediately what's working and what isn't. If you're the kind of editor who gets better with every round of feedback and wants to understand why something performs, not just how it looks, this is the environment for you.

We operate across multiple brands and categories, which means if needed, our editors must have the ability to switch between brand voices and audience types without losing quality or pace.

 

The Role

You'll be editing video content primarily for paid social - UGC ads, direct-response creatives, product-focused content, AI visuals generation, and repurposed organic clips across Meta and TikTok. You'll work from briefs and raw footage provided by our creative strategists and UGC creators, and you'll be expected to turn around polished, platform-ready ads at a reliable pace.

This is a high-output, high-feedback role. You'll be part of a structured creative production workflow, briefs, revisions, performance reviews and the feedback you get will be based on how the content actually performs, not just how it looks.

 

What You'll Be Doing

Core Editing

•    Editing UGC-style and direct-response video ads from raw footage – fast edits [minimum 1.5sec-2 seconds frame changes on visuals], aggressive visuals, clean cuts when needed, strong pacing, and hooks that don't lose the viewer in the first three seconds

•    Applying motion graphics, captions, text overlays, sound design, and music to produce platform-ready content across Meta and TikTok

•    Working from creative briefs and script references you follow the direction but you also bring your eye to it

•    Producing multiple versions of the same concept (hook tests, CTA variations, format cuts) efficiently

Workflow & Collaboration

•    Receiving and interpreting briefs from creative strategists - asking smart questions upfront rather than going back and forth after the first cut

•    Submitting first cuts on time and responding to revision notes quickly and accurately

•    Staying current on UGC trends, editing styles, and platform-native formats and flagging when you see something worth testing

•    Keeping your project files, exports, and asset folders organized according to team SOPs

•    Supporting the team in repurposing high-performing content into new formats when needed

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

•    A strong portfolio of edited video ads -  UGC, direct-response, or DTC brand content; we want to see cuts that are designed to perform, not just look good

•    Proficiency in Premiere Pro and/or CapCut - you can work fast in whichever tool the project calls for

•    Strong sense of pacing - you know when a cut is too slow, when a hook is burying itself, and when to trim

•    Understanding of how paid social video works: hook structure, attention retention, CTA placement, and format differences between Meta and TikTok

•    Reliable output - you can handle multiple concurrent edits and hit deadlines consistently

•    Receptive to feedback, revision rounds are part of the job; taking notes personally isn't

Strong Advantages

•    Experience editing DTC, beauty, wellness, or lifestyle brand content

•    Motion graphics skills , text animations, transitions, lower thirds that go beyond basic templates

•    Experience with AI-assisted editing tools that improve turnaround without sacrificing quality

•    Understanding of what makes a winning ad not just technically clean editing, but structurally effective storytelling

•    Familiarity with the UGC content model and how to make creator footage feel polished without losing authenticity

Instant No's

•    Your portfolio is full of cinematic, long-form, or brand film content with no paid social or direct-response work we're not doing that here

•    You need heavy direction on every edit

•    You treat revision notes as optional suggestions - revisions exist to make the content perform better, and accuracy matters

•    You can't sustain output at volume - this is a high-output environment and pace is part of the job

 

What the First 90 Days Look Like

First 30 Days

•    Complete onboarding: brand immersion, SOP walkthrough, file structure orientation, and creative review process

•    Shadow existing edit requests to understand the standard we hold our output to

•    Begin editing live briefs and establish reliable turnaround time and revision accuracy from day one

60 Days

•    Editing independently with minimal back-and-forth, at this time, you've internalized the brief format and the quality bar

•    Operating at full output capacity across concurrent projects

90 Days

•    A trusted, high-output editor the team doesn't need to micromanage

•    Actively contributing to creative iteration and not just executing briefs but improving them

•    Clear track record of on-time delivery, accurate revisions, and consistent quality

•    Positioned for growth toward a Senior Editor role as the team scales

 

How We Measure Your Performance

•    Output volume - number of completed edits per week against targets

•    Revision rate - how many rounds does it take to get to final approval

•    Turnaround time - from brief receipt to first cut submission

•    Creative contribution - are you bringing ideas, flagging trends, and improving the briefs you receive

•    Ad performance - over time, do the edits you produce correlate with stronger results and are you getting winning ads

 

Compensation & Benefits

•    Competitive monthly rate (contractor) based on experience and portfolio quality

•    Clear growth path: Video Editor ? Senior Video Editor

•    Fully remote - no fixed location, flexible setup

•    Learning & development budget

•    Access to winning ad references and a structured feedback system that actually makes you better

•    Exposure to high-volume, multi-market DTC creative production at real scale

•    Weekly performance reviews with the Creative Director

title: TikTok Content Strategist — Part-Time, Philippines-Based
description:
Is This You?

You've owned a brand's TikTok presence — not just edited videos for one. You built the strategy, d
 what to post and why, watched the numbers, formed a hypothesis, and adjusted. You know what's converting this week. You know which sounds are peaking. You understand why one hook stops thumbs and another doesn't.

Editing is a tool you use. It is not what you are.

If you're primarily a video editor who also posts to TikTok, this role isn't for you. If you're a platform strategist who can also cut and edit, keep reading.

 

What You'll Own

• Strategy first. You'll d
 what content to make, why, and when — for 2–3 DTC product brands in the US natural goods space (bar soap, tallow skincare, freeze-dried pet treats). Footage comes from the brand owner and UGC creators. Your job is to turn that footage into a content strategy that drives real growth.

• Build and own the content calendar. Hit deadlines without being reminded.

• Write hooks that compete. Every video starts with a line or visual that earns the next three seconds. You'll be held to this.

• Select audio with intent — trending sounds, original audio, voiceover decisions. You'll know why you chose what you chose.

• Edit for performance: pacing, completion rate, CTA placement. CapCut or similar. Editing is a means to an end — the end is results.

• Transform UGC and existing footage into original-feeling content. You know how to recut, reframe, and re-score so the algorithm treats it as new. Uncut re-uploads aren't in your vocabulary.

• Use native TikTok formats — Duet, Stitch, Green Screen — as deliberate reach tools, not as features you stumbled across.

• Repurpose top-performing TikToks for Instagram Reels. Manage
 pages as a secondary duty.

• Monitor comments and DMs; flag anything needing owner attention.

• Coordinate with TikTok Shop: product links, affiliate awareness, live selling when applicable.

• Track your own metrics — watch time, saves, shares, follower growth — and deliver a clear weekly summary. Honest numbers, not vanity metrics.

• Proactively bring ideas, trend observations, and competitive intel. Don't wait to be asked.

 

What We're Looking For

Hard Requirements

• Minimum 2 years managing TikTok strategy and growth for a US-market brand or agency client — not just editing videos for one

• Demonstrated results: account growth, engagement lifts, or performance data you can point to and explain

• Fluent written English — you write scripts, captions, and communicate directly with the brand owner

• Comfortable editing in CapCut or equivalent — editing is a required supporting skill, not the job itself

• Async-friendly, reliable, deadline-driven — you treat a posting schedule like a commitment

• Able to work with minimal supervision on a fully remote team

Strong Advantages

• TikTok Shop experience: product linking, affiliate coordination, LIVE commerce awareness

• Proficiency with Duet, Stitch, and Green Screen as strategic reach tools

• Experience in natural products, wellness, pet, or handcrafted goods categories

• Familiarity with US DTC consumer behavior

 

?? TikTok Compliance & Platform Intelligence — Non-Negotiable

These brands operate in regulated-adjacent categories: skincare, pet nutrition, personal care. One post with the wrong claim, a banned audio track, or an undetected policy violation can suppress an account, restrict a shop, or worse.

This role requires someone who treats TikTok's Terms of Service, Community Guidelines, and Commerce Policies as required reading — not fine print.

That means:

• You track policy updates. You know what changed in the last 90 days and what it means for product content.

• You flag risks before posting — not after.

• You know what can and cannot appear in TikTok Shop listings, captions, and on-screen text for health and wellness products.

• You understand duplicate content detection and how to re-edit UGC properly so it registers as original.

• You can explain your compliance reasoning when asked.

Candidates who treat this as a checkbox will not advance. Candidates who treat this as a professional discipline will.

 

What You'll Get

• $350–$550 USD/month, part-time (~20 hours/week) — based on experience and results. Clear path to full-time as the brands grow.

• Fully remote, async-first. No micromanagement, no daily check-ins. Own your schedule as long as deadlines are met.

• Stable, long-term engagement — not a project hire. The right person grows with us.

• Clean scope. No customer service, no inventory, no tasks outside your lane.

• Direct access to the brand owner — fast decisions, real feedback, good work recognized.

 

How to Apply

Send the following via onlinejobs.ph message:

1. A brief intro (3–5 sentences): who you are, what TikTok accounts or brands you've managed, and one result you drove that you're proud of.

2. Links to 2–3 TikTok accounts you've managed. If under NDA, describe the account — but be specific about what you did and what happened.

3. Your answer to this required question. No answer = no consideration:

"Name one TikTok rule, policy change, or platform update from the last 6 months that could affect a US e-commerce brand selling physical products. How would you handle it — in your content approach and in what you'd communicate to the brand owner?"

Answer in your own words. A vague or generic response tells us everything we need to know.

 

These are small, real brands built around products people genuinely love. We're not filling a seat — we're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, wants a stable long-term role, and is ready to grow alongside us. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

Full Stack Developer (Angular / AWS) — Remote, Full-Time

- Define and deploy infrastructure with AWS SAM

- Configure CloudFront for fast, secure delivery of assets and APIs

- Work directly with product and design to shape the UX

- 5+ years of professional web application development

- Strong Angular (v10+) with TypeScript/JavaScript

- Hands-on serverless experience with AWS Lambda

- Python on the backend

- AWS SAM for infrastructure and deployments

- CloudFront experience (CDN, caching, secure delivery)

- Serious UI skills: advanced CSS (Flexbox, Grid, animations, responsive layouts), solid UI/UX fundamentals, a real eye for layout, spacing, typography, and visual hierarchy

- Strong web fundamentals: HTML5, REST APIs, HTTP, browser behavior, performance

- Unit/component testing (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, or similar)

- Comfortable with Git and standard branching workflows

- Able to work independently, communicate clearly, and collaborate without hand-holding



BONUS POINTS (NOT REQUIRED)

- Angular component libraries or design systems (Material, PrimeNG, custom)

Remote and async-friendly. Small team, real ownership, no micromanagement — but high standards. You'll have a genuine say in how things get built.

title: Wedding Photo Editor
description:
# Wedding Photo Editor – Contract Position



## Overview



Vaughan Visuals is seeking a reliable wedding photo editor to assist with post-production on wedding galleries. This is a contract-based position with the opportunity for ongoing work as booking volume increases.



The ideal candidate has experience editing wedding photography, maintaining color consistency throughout a gallery, and delivering clean, natural-looking edits that match an established editing style.



## Workflow



* All photos will be culled prior to delivery.

* Our lead photographer will edit approximately 100–120 images from each wedding gallery for previews, social media content, and style reference.

* Lightroom presets will be provided.

* Multiple edited sample images from the wedding will be provided as color and style references.

* The editor will be responsible for matching the remaining gallery to the established look and feel.



## Responsibilities



* Apply provided Lightroom presets and make necessary adjustments.

* Match color grading and overall style to photographer-edited reference images.

* Adjust exposure, white balance, contrast, highlights, shadows, and color balance as needed.

* Correct horizons and minor composition alignment issues when necessary.

* Maintain consistency across the entire gallery.

* Export and return edited files according to provided specifications.

* Edit roughly
culled photos depending on the shoot



## Requirements



* Experience editing wedding photography.

* Proficiency in Adobe Lightroom

* Strong understanding of color correction and white balance.

* Ability to closely match an existing editing style.

* Attention to detail and consistency throughout large galleries.

* Ability to meet agreed-upon turnaround times.



## Editing Style



We prioritize:



* Clean, timeless edits

* Natural skin tones

* Consistent color throughout the gallery

* True-to-life whites and balanced exposures

* A polished, professional look without overly aggressive editing



## What We Provide



* Fully culled RAW files

* Lightroom presets

* 100–120 edited reference images from the wedding

* Clear export specifications

* Ongoing communication and feedback



## To Apply



Please provide:



* Examples of wedding galleries you have edited

* Typical turnaround times

* Pricing structure (per image or per gallery)

* Any information about your workflow and experience matching established editing styles

title: Technology Delivery Lead
description:
WeFlex helps people with a disability, people in aged care, and Australian war veterans live longer, healthier lives through access to physical fitness, allied health and therapy supports. We're a registered NDIS provider. We've delivered over 50,000 sessions, grown 30x in 2.5 years, and we plan to keep doubling every year.



The seat

Our COO sets the business priorities. Your job is to make them ship.



You sit between the business and the build. A priority comes in ("clients aren't reporting back", "kill our legacy CRM"). You work out the real problem, scope it, sequence it, build part of it yourself, and run the delivery cadence so the team ships the rest, tested and documented.



How the tech function is structured:



The COO owns vision and business priorities. She d
 what matters and approves what gets built.

You, the Technology Delivery Lead, own the delivery engine: intake, scoping, sequencing, sprint cadence, BAU stability, documentation, and the development of our two junior devs. You also build.

Our Technology Solutions & Data Lead is your senior peer. He owns deep architecture, data and AI capability, and takes the hardest technical problems.

Two junior developers report to you.

Day-to-day you work directly with the COO. She sets priorities, you align the delivery plan with her, and development runs through scoping and review gates to catch mistakes early.



What you'll do day-to-day

Turn business problems into specs. You take an ambiguous brief from an exec and produce a scoped doc: the actual problem, what's in and out of scope, requirements with acceptance criteria, and how we'll test it.

Run delivery. Sprint cadence, ClickUp board, intake triage, dependencies, blockers raised early, weekly delivery reporting. You always know the status of everything in flight.

Build. You personally ship mid-complexity automations and systems: n8n workflows, Airtable systems, integrations across Supabase, GoHighLevel, Zendesk, Xero and our internal portals.

Keep the lights on. Bugs triaged, broken automations fixed or routed, systems stable, documentation current.

Coach. You review the juniors' work, pair with them on problems, and keep the quality bar high.

On AI

This part is a hard requirement. Claude, GPT, Cursor or equivalents need to already be core to how you diagnose, scope, build and document. The most effective tech lead we've had wasn't our strongest raw developer. He was the best we've seen at using AI to close that gap, and he out-shipped people with twice his experience. We hire for that pattern. The build task is where you show us yours.



Who fits

Your career path looks something like business analyst, then product owner, then delivery or tech lead, ideally on a live software product. Ten years of solo senior-engineer titles is the wrong path for this seat.

You've run delivery inside someone else's structure (a PM system, a product org, an exec's priorities) and got good at it.

You've shipped real automations and systems yourself and can show them: workflows, integrations, internal tools.

You've developed juniors who got measurably better under you, and you can name them when we ask for references.

You write plain business English. A COO can read your specs and Looms without a translator.

We weight what you can actually do over degrees, years of experience or industry background.



What this role isn't

A strategy seat. The COO owns business priorities and the roadmap; this role turns them into delivered systems.

A heavy DevOps, Kubernetes or infrastructure role. We run managed low-code at scale.

Open to agencies or dev shops. Individual, exclusive, full-time applicants only. No concurrent client work.

Pay and logistics

PHP 90,000 to 220,000 per month, depending on demonstrated capability.

Full-time, fully remote, AEST-aligned hours, Philippines-based.

To apply

Submit here: 



Two parts:



Part 1: application form. CV, portfolio link, 7 short written answers, notice period and salary expectation.



Part 2: build task. A real WeFlex scenario with sample data. You build a working artifact and record a short Loom walking through your thinking, your tool choice and your AI workflow. There's no time limit. We score the quality of the build.



We don't review applications without a completed build task. It's the highest-weight signal in our process.



Reviewed weekly. Open until filled.

title: VSL Video Editor
description:
OVERVIEW

We are looking for a skilled VSL (Video Sales Letter) Editor who can craft long-form, high-converting video content for e-commerce and DTC brands. This is not a short-form or social media role — you will own the full VSL production pipeline, turning raw scripts, footage, and voiceovers into polished sales videos that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

• VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent.

• DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA.

• Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points.

• Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

• Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

• Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.

• Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders.



MUST-HAVES

• Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines.

• Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually.

• Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats.

• Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats).

• Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism.

• Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours.



BONUS SKILLS

• Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs.

• Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics.

• Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video).

• Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow.

• Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats.



ENGAGEMENT DETAILS:

Schedule Flexible / output-based — strict deadlines apply

Onboarding Paid trial project before transitioning to ongoing engagement

title: Strategic Website Designer, Figma + Website Strategy
description:
Full-Time Remote Role, Philippines-Based

----------------------------------------------------------

We are looking for a full-time Strategic Website Designer based in the Philippines.



This role is ideal for someone who is strong in Figma, understands website design, and can think strategically about clients, their customers, brand direction, industry patterns, and what makes a website work.



This is not just a production design role. We are looking for someone who can understand the brief, think through the customer journey, research competitors, recommend website direction, and then support that direction in Figma.



Role Overview

-------------------

You will help turn client goals, customer needs, brand direction, website references, and competitor research into a clear internal website strategy and design direction.



You do not need to lead client calls, but you must be able to sit in meetings, understand what clients are saying, extract the important points, and translate that into useful internal notes, design direction, and Figma updates.



You will work closely with our internal team across website strategy, design, and delivery





Key Responsibilities

---------------------------

- Review client briefs, meeting notes, recordings, brand assets, and website references

- Understand what the client wants, what their customers need, and what the website needs to achieve

- Analyse websites the client likes and dislikes

- Research competitor websites and industry patterns

- Identify trust signals, conversion sections, content structure, and visual styles that work in each industry

- Recommend website direction based on customer needs and business goals

- Create look-and-feel concepts in Figma

- Create new website sections in Figma

- Improve layout, spacing, hierarchy, flow, and visual polish

- Update existing Figma designs based on internal direction

- Write clear internal notes explaining design decisions and strategic recommendations

- Keep ClickUp tasks updated with progress, blockers, and time entries

- Communicate clearly with the team via Slack and Google Docs

- Use ChatGPT to support research, summaries, and strategic thinking where useful



What We Are Looking For

-----------------------------------

You should be a mid-to-senior-level website designer with strong strategic thinking.



You should be able to take messy input and turn it into clear website direction.



We are looking for someone who can think before designing.



A strong candidate can say:

“Based on the customer’s needs, the homepage should build trust early, show proof, and make the offer clear, reduce friction, and use a more premium visual direction because the market is crowded.”



A weak candidate only says:

“I can make modern websites in Figma.”



We are looking for the first type.





Required Skills

---------------------

- Strong Figma skills

- Website design experience

- Ability to create new website sections, not just edit existing designs

- Good understanding of layout, spacing, hierarchy, and visual polish

- Ability to create early look-and-feel concepts

- Ability to understand client brands

- Ability to analyse competitor websites

- Ability to understand customer needs and website goals

- Clear written English for internal notes and design rationale

- Good communication in Slack and Google Docs

- Comfortable using ClickUp for task updates and time tracking

- Comfortable using ChatGPT as a thinking and research support tool



English Requirement

-----------------------------

You do not need to be a copywriter or client presenter.



However, you must be able to write clear internal notes, summarise client requirements, explain design decisions, and provide simple website section direction.



Example of the level we need:

“The client wants the site to feel modern, premium, and trustworthy. Their customers are likely comparing providers, so the homepage should quickly communicate credibility, outcomes, and service clarity. The reference websites suggest they prefer clean layouts, strong imagery, and simple navigation.”



Tools You Must Be Comfortable With

----------------------------------------------------

- Figma

- ClickUp

- Slack

- Google Docs

- ChatGPT



Work Hours

-----------------

This is a full-time role.



You must be available to work:

- 9:00 am to 5:30 pm Australian Eastern Standard Time



For candidates in the Philippines, this is usually around:

- 7:00 am to 3:30 pm Philippines time



Please only apply if you can work these hours long-term.



Role Structure

-------------------

- Full-time remote contractor role

- Philippines-based candidates only

- 3-month probation period

- If successful after probation, the role continues on the same agreed monthly salary

- 1 week notice during probation

- 2 weeks' notice after probation

- Unpaid leave only

- Contractor must provide their own laptop, stable internet, and suitable work setup

- This is a fully exclusive role. You must not work with other clients while engaged in this role

- Daily time tracking is required in ClickUp

- No screenshots or activity monitoring required

- Confidentiality and IP ownership agreement required



Access and Confidentiality

------------------------------------

You will have access to internal documentation, project files, client information, Figma files, brand assets, and other materials required to do the role well.



All work created during the role, including strategy notes, design concepts, Figma files, website layouts, written documentation, research outputs, and related assets, will be owned by the company.



You may not share client work publicly, use it in a portfolio, or reuse it elsewhere without written approval.





Who This Role Is Not For

---------------------------------

Please do not apply if:

- You only want to follow the exact design instructions

- You are not comfortable thinking strategically

- You cannot explain your design decisions

- You do not like researching competitors or industries

- You only want production design tasks

- You cannot work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST

- You are currently working with other clients and want to keep doing so

- You are not comfortable with ClickUp time tracking





How To Apply

--------------------

Submit your application to 



Please include the following in your application:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your Figma portfolio or links to website design work

3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

4. Confirmation that you can work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST

5. Confirmation that you are available for a full-time exclusive role

6. A short answer to this question:



“Tell us about a website you designed or improved. What was the client trying to achieve, and who was the

customer, and why did you choose that design direction?”



Applications that only say “I am interested” without answering the above will not be considered

title: Tech Operations Executive Assistant
description:
# Role Summary



We are seeking a **Technical Operations Executive Assistant** to serve as a high-functioning operational partner. This role sits at the intersection of executive assistance, operations management, and technical execution. It is designed for someone who is equally comfortable analyzing data in Google Sheets, setting up a new tool from a tutorial, attending tea
etings to absorb context, and turning a fast-paced brain dump into a structured action plan.



The ideal candidate is analytically sharp, highly adaptable, and genuinely tech-savvy — not someone who follows instructions step by step, but someone who understands the why behind tasks, anticipates needs, and proactively builds structure where none exists. This role acts as a filter between the principal and the sales team, managing information flow and ensuring nothing critical falls through the cracks.



# Key Responsibilities



## Executive Support & Daily Shadowing



- Attend tea
etings and shadow the principal throughout the day to build deep context and institutional knowledge

- Act as the communication filter between the sales team and the principal — fielding questions and resolving issues independently where possible

- Serve as an active sounding board: listen to brain dumps, ask the right clarifying questions, and convert ideas into structured, actionable plans

- Manage the principal’s personal inbox and Slack — triaging messages, drafting responses, and flagging priority items

- Handle calendar scheduling, task prioritization, and daily operational setup to keep the principal’s day on track



## Data Management & Analysis



- Clean, organize, and maintain sales rep data across CRM platforms and spreadsheets

- Filter and manage lead lists to ensure data accuracy and usability for the sales team

- Build and maintain Google Sheets trackers, formulas, and pivot tables for operational reporting

- Pull, compile, and send call recordings as needed for review or quality assurance

- Conduct data analysis to surface insights, flag anomalies, and support decision-making



## CRM & Systems Management



- Manage and maintain lead and contact records across Close CRM and Go High Level (GHL)

- Set up new tools and integrations independently using available documentation or tutorials — no hand-holding required

- Configure and manage platforms such as Sendinblue (Brevo) and iClose as directed

- Ensure CRM pipelines, workflows, and automations are running accurately and efficiently

- Identify gaps in existing systems and recommend or implement improvements proactively



## Operations & Automation



- Build and manage backend automations to streamline repeatable tasks across sales and operations

- Think analytically to identify automation opportunities — not just execute what is requested, but engineer solutions from scratch

- Support the development of a “second brain” system using AI tools for information filtering, task management, and decision support

- Handle cross-functional repeatable tasks spanning sales management, CBA operations, and general business administration

- Document processes and standard operating procedures as systems are built and refined



# Skills & Qualifications



## Non-Negotiable Skills



- Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets, including complex formulas and pivot tables

- Familiarity with Slack and Google Calendar for communication and scheduling management

- Experience with LLMs and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) for productivity and task support

- Strong data analysis skills — ability to work with raw data sets, identify patterns, and produce clean outputs

- Exceptional listening and communication skills — able to extract structure from fast-paced or scattered verbal direction



## Technical Skills



- Hands-on experience with Close CRM and/or Go High Level (GHL)

- Ability to set up and configure SaaS tools independently using tutorials and documentation

- Experience building or managing automations within CRM or workflow platforms

- Familiarity with call tracking systems and the ability to pull and manage call recordings

- Comfort with Manus or equivalent AI productivity and automation tools (preferred)



## Preferred Qualifications



- Previous experience as an EA or Operations Manager supporting a sales-led organization

- Background working directly with a founder, senior executive, or team leader in a high-autonomy capacity

- Experience managing or filtering communication between leadership and a sales team

- Track record of building operational systems or automations from the ground up

- Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments with shifting priorities



# Tools & Platforms



Required: Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Slack, Close CRM, Go High Level (GHL), LLMs (Claude / ChatGPT)



Preferred: Manus, Sendinblue (Brevo), iClose, call tracking platforms



Please send your updated resume along with a 1-2min self intro to apply.
