title: AI video Editor
description:
Hi,



We’re looking for a second video editor / content assistant to help us scale our ads and organic content faster.



We already have one editor, but we need an additional editor so we can produce, test and publish more content at a higher speed.



Our workflow is structured as follows:



1. We film raw footage such as vlogs, screen recordings, educational videos, ads and behind-the-scenes content.

2. Our virality expert reviews the raw footage and provides direction, including timestamps of the best parts, angles and moments.

3. Based on those timestamps and instructions, your first task is to cut the raw footage into a cleaner version, which we call “Raw Footage 2.0”.

4. Our virality expert then reviews Raw Footage 2.0 and provides new timestamps for the final long-form and short-form content.

5. Your job is then to cut those timestamps into final long-form and short-form videos.



The main tasks are:



- Cut raw footage based on timestamps and direction from our virality expert

- Create “Raw Footage 2.0” from the original raw footage

- Cut Raw Footage 2.0 into final long-form and short-form videos based on new timestamps (for Tiktok, IG reels, Youtube shorts, Ads, Linkedin)

- Use AI tools to help with cutting, editing, clip selection and speeding up the workflow!

- Use AI tools to generate subtitles in Dutch

- Make sure the final videos are clean, well-paced and ready to publish

- Follow our existing workflow and editing style



You do not need to decide the strategy or come up with the content angles yourself. The direction and timestamps will be provided by our virality expert. However, you do need to be accurate, organized and able to cut footage in a clean and efficient way.



Requirements:



- Experience with short-form content editing

- Experience with long-form editing

- Experience using AI tools for video editing, cutting, clip selection and subtitles

- Able to work accurately with timestamps

- Good sense of pacing and clean cuts

- Comfortable using tools such as Vizard AI, OpusClip, Descript, CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar tools

- Reliable communication

- Able to work fast and follow a repeatable process



Please send:



1. Your hourly rate and how many hours are you available?

2. Share 3 links to short?form and or longform you edited yourself.

3. Which editing tools you use

4. What’s your internet speed? (screenshot)

5. When can you work in CET time? (we need 2–3h overlap)

6. Which AI tools you have experience with for cutting, editing and subtitles

7. How many 30–60s clips can you realistically finish per working hour at high quality?

8. How many videos you can edit per week

9. Your availability for ongoing work



Important: We are not looking for someone who only makes flashy edits. We need someone who is organized, fast, accurate with timestamps, comfortable with AI tools and able to follow a repeatable content workflow.



This can become long-term work if the first test project goes well.



Thank you.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Native)
description:
I'm Connor, founder of AdStream. I'm based in Australia and I run this company small and fast.



AdStream manages the ad creative workflow for e-commerce brands running creator-made (UGC) video ads at volume: creative briefs go out, creators upload video, the brand's team reviews and approves everything in the browser, and approved ads publish straight to Meta.



See it for yourself before you apply. Make an account at 
, click around, poke at the brief and review flows. The best applications come from people who've actually touched the product.



What we're building right now

Video playback. Reviewers play and scrub large creator videos in the browser, and right now playback is laggy. We serve full-quality source files straight from S3, so reviewers wait on buffering instead of reviewing.



The route forward is Drive-first: Google Drive becomes the home for every customer asset. That gets us three things at once, fast playback on large files, customer assets living in their own Google Drive (a place they control and a brand they already trust), and the foundation for semantic search. That last one is the exciting part: once every file lands in Drive, we process it, get the transcript and text embeddings so you can search what's said in a video, frame embeddings so you can search what's visually in it. "Find b-roll with a kettle on a table." "Pull every clip where someone says sustainable." Internal teams find images, b-roll and past ads in seconds instead of scrubbing through folders, which makes video editing and graphic design dramatically faster.



Beyond that, the roadmap you'd own: deepening the Meta integration and adding TikTok (OAuth, campaign publishing, status webhooks), AI creative generation with OpenAI, and Stripe billing.



The stack

Next.js 15 (App Router, server actions) + React 19 + TypeScript. Tailwind v4. Supabase — Postgres with row-level security, auth, storage. AWS S3. Google Drive API. Meta Graph API. OpenAI. Deployed on Vercel.



You don't need prior experience with every line, but be honest about which parts you haven't touched, and don't propose a rewrite in week two.



This is an AI-native role

We provide a paid Claude Code seat and cover your AI tooling. You must already work this way daily, agentic tools (Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent), not autocomplete. You can write a spec an agent can execute, review agent output critically instead of trusting it, and verify AI-written code before it ships. One senior with a real agentic workflow now ships what a small team shipped a few years ago, that's the bet this role is built on.



How we work:



A 10–20 minute call every morning: what's planned today, review of yesterday, check in on deadlines.

We agree on milestones upfront so everyone stays accountable.

Be upfront about how long things will take. Not so we can micromanage, so we can be honest with our users and set expectations they can trust. Don't tell us it's a day if it's a week.

Own outcomes, not tasks. Questions early, blockers immediately.

Async outside the morning call: Looms, written updates. Hours are 9am–5pm AEST — a normal 7am–3pm day shift in the Philippines, evenings free.



How to apply:



Start your application with the exact phrase "Drive-first." It tells me you actually read this.



Record a Loom (5 minutes max — clear and tight beats thorough and rambling) covering:

You and your work. Quick intro, then walk me through something real you've shipped, what it does and what you built.

AI doing meaningful work. One real example of using an agent for something substantial: how you directed it, something it got wrong that you caught, and how you verified it before shipping. I want to see judgment, not AI slop.

How AI changed your workflow. How much more do you ship now? Do you still write most lines by hand, or mostly review and direct?

Your models. Which model do you prefer and why? Do you run more than one, and how do you split work between them?



If your Loom lands, we'll jump on a call.



Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: VSL Video Editor
description:
OVERVIEW

We are looking for a skilled VSL (Video Sales Letter) Editor who can craft long-form, high-converting video content for e-commerce and DTC brands. This is not a short-form or social media role — you will own the full VSL production pipeline, turning raw scripts, footage, and voiceovers into polished sales videos that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

•	VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent.

•	DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA.

•	Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points.

•	Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

•	Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

•	Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.

•	Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders.



MUST-HAVES

•	Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes.

•	Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines.

•	Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually.

•	Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats.

•	Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats).

•	Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism.

•	Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours.



BONUS SKILLS

•	Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs.

•	Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics.

•	Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video).

•	Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow.

•	Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats.

Onboarding	Paid trial project before transitioning to ongoing engagement

title: Instagram/Facebook Growth + Sales VA (US Student Brand) — Closer, Not Just Admin
description:
We're a U.S.-based student discount membership (college town in North Carolina) and we're hiring ONE sharp social media + sales VA to help us grow fast before the fall semester. This is not a quiet admin job. Your #1 mission is to get students to sign up, by running Instagram/Facebook content and DMing students in a casual, human way that actually converts.

What you'll do:

• Find and DM the right students on Instagram (we give you the scripts and a clear daily process)

Pay: $600/month equivalent for part-time, made up of a base plus per-sale bonuses and milestone bonuses when we hit our growth goals — so the better you perform, the more you earn. We pay reliably via Wise/PayPal. Strong performers move to more hours and higher pay for the launch sprint.

 or Reel idea for broke college students in a small U.S. college town.

title: Account & Driver Partnership Specialist
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website:

Benefit: PTO and HMO after the 120-day probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide

Performance Bonus: Starts at approximately USD 300–700 per month on average, with potential for higher earnings based on performance. 



About the role:



As an Account & Driver Partnerships Specialist, you will own the operational health of a specific US market. You'll start by learning that market inside and out, its clients, its drivers, its trip patterns, and from there, you'll wear two hats every day. Both are essential to how Wingz works.



On the client side, you'll act as the dedicated account manager for our partnered NEMT brokers, the organizations that send trip requests for their members. You'll handle daily B2B communication, trip coordination, escalation management, and performance reporting. Your job is to build a strong partnership with each broker and earn their trust until Wingz is their most reliable carrier in the market. That trust matters — it's what causes brokers to route more trips to us. And once they do, you'll own the commitment to make sure every assigned trip gets completed safely and on time.



On the driver side, you'll own the full driver lifecycle in your market, recruitment, onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention. That means walking new drivers through every requirement, procedure, and process so they can confidently join the NEMT industry with Wingz. It means proactively reaching out to inactive drivers and reactivating them. It means being the human point of contact that keeps drivers engaged, earning, and partnered with us long-term — because retention isn't built on incentives, it's built on relationships.



This is a foundational individual-contributor role, by design. You'll start at the rank-and-file level because the path forward at Wingz is clear: Specialist ? Senior Specialist ? Market Lead. We're not hiring for a job; we're hiring for a career, and the people who learn the Wingz foundation now are the leaders we promote into the next phase of growth.



Key Responsibilities:



• Learn your market first. Get to know the clients, the drivers, the trip patterns, and the relationships that make your assigned market work; your fluency here is the foundation for everything else.

• Build strong partnerships with our NEMT broker clients. Show up consistently, communicate clearly, and follow through every time. Your goal is to make Wingz the trusted, reliable carrier in your market, so brokers route more trips to us.

• Commit to trip completion. Once a trip is assigned to Wingz, you own it. Coordinate with drivers, monitor trips in progress, and resolve issues quickly so every member gets to their appointment safely and on time.

• Onboard new drivers into the Wingz partnership. Walk them through every requirement, procedure, and process, documentation, background checks, vehicle readiness, so they can confidently join the NEMT industry as a Wingz partner driver.

• Activate inactive drivers. Make the calls, understand what's holding them back, and get them back on the road.

• Drive partner-driver success. Be the human point of contact our drivers can count on. Build loyalty, prevent churn, and grow retention in your market, because every retained driver is one we don't have to replace.

• Help drivers grow their daily earnings. Where needed, coordinate trip assignments and dispatch so your drivers see consistent, meaningful daily income. Strong earnings are what keep drivers partnered with Wingz long-term.

• Step into adjacent responsibilities as the team scales, operations support, dispatch backup, training new hires, and wherever the business needs you most.

• Bring market-level insights back to the wider Wingz team to inform how we improve.



Qualifications:



• Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience. Client relations, account management, partner success, leadership or supervisory roles, or experience handling drivers and partners at a US-based, or international transportation, rideshare, logistics, or gig-economy company (Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart, Rappi, DiDi, Cabify, 99, iFood, PedidosYa, inDrive, Loggi, Bolt, Wolt, or similar). What matters is the underlying skill set, not the exact job title.

• Experience working directly with US-based clients or a US-based company. You're already comfortable with US business culture, US English, and the pace of a US-facing role.

• Strong written and verbal English communication. Clear, professional, and warm, you'll be working with US-based clients and drivers every day.

• Tech-savvy with strong initiative to learn. Quick to pick up new platforms (CRM, dispatch software, reporting tools, AI tools), and ready to step into adjacent tasks so your market never loses 
ntum.

• Available to work US Eastern Standard Time (EST). Shift schedules are set based on market and business needs; flexibility is part of the role.

• Proven remote work experience. You've worked from home effectively before, with minimal supervision, the discipline to manage your own day, and a track record of delivering outcomes without someone over your shoulder.

• Your own reliable computer, stable home internet, and a professional remote workspace. All work-from-home equipment is self-provided.

• Proactive, independent, and ownership-minded. You see what needs to be done and do it. You manage your own day, take initiative without waiting for permission, and treat your market's results as your own.

• Curious, coachable, and dedicated. You want to understand why things work, you apply feedback fast, and you measure your contribution in outcomes delivered, not hours logged.

• Passionate about growth. You're here to grow into leadership, not to coast. You bring the energy and follow-through to earn the next role.

About the Role



I run a growing membership and online course business in the medical/aesthetics education space. It's an established business with a long track record, loyal customers, and serious room to grow.



I'm looking for ONE full-time, exclusive Virtual Assistant to become the operational backbone of this business. This is not a side gig, not a part-time role, and not one client among many. This is a long-term, full-time career position for someone who wants stability, growth, and real responsibility.



Why this is a great opportunity:



You'll work directly with a founder with years of experience in this space — you'll learn skills and gain experience that compound for years.

This is a stable, long-term commitment. I want someone who grows with the business for years, not months.

You won't just execute tasks — you'll run things. Over time, you'll take ownership of operations so I can focus on growth. You're essentially a business partner who makes our digital products run.



What You'll Do



Manage our membership site month to month: updating monthly deliverables, uploading new assets, keeping content organized and on schedule.

Coordinate directly with our graphic designer — requesting assets, giving feedback, tracking deadlines, and making sure deliverables are ready on time every month.

Make edits and updates to our Squarespace website (pages, content, layout updates).

Create and edit designs in Canva following our brand guidelines.

Handle general business operations: organizing files, managing schedules and recurring tasks, keeping systems documented and running.

Communicate proactively: send regular updates on what's done, what's in progress, and what needs my attention — so nothing falls through the cracks.

Take ownership. When something breaks or is unclear, you figure it out or flag it early. The goal is that I can step away and trust that the business keeps running.



What I Provide



Full-time, stable monthly salary (paid reliably, on time)

Brand guidelines, templates, and documented processes

Direct training and mentorship fro
 as you learn the business

A long-term role with growing responsibility (and compensation that grows with it)

Paid onboarding period to learn our systems



What I Expect



Exclusivity: This is a FULL-TIME role. No other clients, no side jobs. I'm paying for your full focus and in return offering stability and long-term growth. Please do not apply if you plan to keep other clients.

Reliability: Available during agreed working hours, responsive to messages, consistent day-to-day.

Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. If something is at risk of being late or wrong, you raise it early.

Proactive communication: Regular status updates without being asked. I should always know how things are going.

Trustworthiness: You'll have access to business systems and accounts. Integrity and discretion are non-negotiable.

Attention to detail: Membership deliverables go out to paying customers — accuracy and polish matter.



Skills I'm Looking For



Proven experience with Canva (design and editing within brand guidelines)

Experience making edits in Squarespace (or a similar website builder, with willingness to master Squarespace fast)

Experience managing a membership site, course platform, or recurring content/deliverables schedule

Strong general operations skills: organized, systems-minded, good with checklists and deadlines

Excellent written and spoken English

Experience coordinating with other contractors (designers, editors, etc.) is a big plus

Bonus: familiarity with online courses, digital products, or the medical/aesthetics industry



Compensation



Full-time monthly salary

Long-term stability: I'm hiring for years, not a project



How to Apply



To apply, include the following in your message:



Type "pineapple" in the first line of your application so I know you read the full posting.

A 2-minute video introduction: who you are, where you're from, and why a long-term, exclusive full-time role appeals to you.

Examples of your work: Canva designs you've created and/or websites you've managed or edited (Squarespace especially).

A short description of a time you managed something end-to-end for a client or employer (a project, a site, a recurring process) — what it was and what you were responsible for.

Confirm that you are available full-time with no other clients, and your expected monthly salary.



Next Steps



If your application stands out, I'll invite you to a 30–45 minute video interview.

Finalists will complete a paid test project (a realistic sample of the actual work: a Canva task, a Squarespace edit, and a coordination/communication exercise).

From there, I'll choose one person to start with a paid trial month, leading to the permanent full-time role.



This is the right fit if you want one stable, full-time position where you're trusted with real responsibility, paid reliably, and given the chance to grow into the operational leader of an established digital business.

title: Looking for an EXPERT editor for ecommerce business
description:
Are YOU an experienced VSL Video Editor for meta ads (especially in the healthy niche)? Do you excel working in a fast-paced and results oriented leadership team? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.



We run an healthy/wellness brand and we're looking for an expert VSL Video Editor to join our team.



We need someone to take responsibility for:



- Fast Delivery without sacrifice quality (Both quality and speed are essential)

- Work 8 hours per day for a total of 40 hours weekly producing 1/2 VSL video per day with a minimum duration of 2 minutes.

- Create 3 different Hooks Variations x video.

- Finding parts of raw clips independently.

- Use clips pertaining strictly to the script.

- High story telling skills and ability to convey emotion from script to video.

- Use professional editing with visual effects, sound effects, transitions, motion graphics, etc.

- The videos produced must keep viewer retention very high, so use effects and clips very frequently.

- Carefully check once the video is finished that everything is correct (clips used pertaining to the script, texts written correctly, etc.).

- The videos will be in French, but we will also send the same script in English for better understanding. It is not necessary to know French, but flexibility is needed.

- The videos (and generally the clips used) should all be of high quality.

- Videos must be regularly produced within one day of script delivery and delivered following future directions.

- Use AI-powered tools and software proficiently to enhance and accelerate video production (e.g. AI clip generation, AI-assisted editing, etc.).

- Create and produce high-quality video scripts optimized for VSL formats and Meta ad performance.

- Create ultra-realistic AI avatar videos with lip-sync capabilities, using tools such as HeyGen, Synthesia, or similar platforms, to produce compelling spokesperson-style content.



Position Requirements:

- Proven experience as a VSL video editor for Meta Ads.

- Proficiency with professional editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve or similar).

- Strong skills in motion graphics, transitions, sound design, and subtitles/captions.

- Strong skills in hooks creation, scroll stoppers e attention grabber.

- Ability to adapt editing style to different formats and target audiences.

- Good understanding of social media and performance marketing (knowing what makes a video engaging and high-converting).

- Proven proficiency with AI video creation tools (e.g. HeyGen, Synthesia, Runway, Kling, or similar) for generating ultra-realistic lip-sync AI avatar videos.

- Strong script-writing skills with the ability to craft clear, persuasive, and well-structured VSL scripts that convert.

- Hands-on experience leveraging AI software throughout the video production workflow to maximize quality and output speed.

- No freelancer mentality. This is a full-time job. You will be paid by the hour, not by project.

- Fluent in English (spoken and written) – French is a plus.

- Full-time availability with fast turnaround times and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Complete availability to the company, so other freelancer works are not possible.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver polished, professional results consistently.

- Creative mindset with problem-solving skills and openness to feedback.

- Reliable, proactive, and communicative personality – someone who takes ownership of the work and respond quickly, concisely and efficiently.



If you meet all the requirements, including taking on the various responsibilities mentioned above, please fill out the form below and if you are a good fit, you will be contacted in the following days to get to know you better: 







NOTE: Applications that do not fill out the form above will not be considered.

This is your chance to work closely with a dynamic team, tackle exciting challenges, and play a key role in a fast-paced and rewarding environment. If you're proactive, resourceful, and thrive under pressure, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Remote Webinar Copywriter (AI-Assisted)
description:
If you enjoy building high-converting webinar presentations, following a clear, systematic process, and using AI to scale your writing, keep reading.



About us:

We’re the Creade Club. We coach Sport-Creators to benefit more from their audience. Clients are mostly successful Sport-Creators who are having trouble improving their business further.



We’re now hiring a Remote Webinar Copywriter to help us build high-converting presentations for our clients. The job is creative but systematic: you don't invent decks from scratch; you adapt a proven structure to each client. Your focus is strictly on the text/copy—the words on each slide. You are not designing anything. We do this work using Claude AI, so the whole build runs as a guided process inside a Claude project.



What you’ll do:

- Run guided AI workflows

- Adapt proven structures

- Manage slide tiers

- Define key variables

- Perfect the pacing

- You are not designing



What we provide:

- Detailed client intake forms containing all the raw material you need.

- Structural wireframes (marked with evergreen and near-evergreen identifiers) to act as your map.

- Starter prompts to load into Claude AI to initiate the build smoothly.

- Examples of high-converting presentations to reference for pacing and structural adaptation.



You’re a fit if:

- You know when to write fresh copy and when to leave proven "evergreen" assets alone.

- You understand how to pace a presentation for speaking, using sentence fragments rather than paragraphs.

- You have excellent editorial judgment and can synthesize a client's core promise into a highly effective opening "Hook."

- You enjoy directing and refining AI outputs rather than writing every single word from a blank page.



Requirements:

Strong editorial and copywriting skills, specifically for spoken presentations or webinars.

Comfortable operating workflows within AI platforms like Claude.

Available for team communication and questions between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM German time (your actual working hours are flexible).

Strong written and spoken English.

Reliable internet, a working computer, a webcam, and a quiet place to work.



How to apply: 

This is a short form where we ask about your experience, portfolio (please include copywriting or presentation examples), and availability.



If it looks like a potential fit on paper, we’ll offer you an assessment task to test how you run our Claude workflow.



Top candidates from the assessment task will be invited to a short 1:1 call and a paid trial period.



Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Remote
